decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (24 Rev. C and 051439 Rev. B, received 20 September 2013; 014 Rev. D, received 8 November 2013, and 013 Rev. E, received 18 November 2013) approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 3 - The construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted alterations and additions shall be in accordance with the materials approved by the Local Planning Authority under 01076/G/P16(3) on 7 April 2011; and 01076/G/P16(3i) on 28 January 2013.
Condition : 4 - The restaurant and public house premises shall close, and all customers shall have left the premises for the night, by midnight Sunday to Thursday and 12.30am Friday and Saturday.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority. The flat roof shall only be used in the case of an emergency as a fire exit.

Condition : 6 - Before any part of the development is occupied, the scheme of extract ducting and external condensers, including anti-vibration mountings to all fans, shall be installed and maintained in accordance with the details and specification(s) as shown on the approved drawings and as set out in the Environment Noise Assessment Report dated November 2013, with noise from the pant/ equipment to be a minimum of 10dB below the background noise level measured 1m outside the window of the nearest residential property.

Condition : 7 - The access doorway to the entrance from Thames Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 8 - The acoustic insulation (minimum 15mm thick insulate/acoustic plaster board) shown on drawing 013 Rev. E, received 18 November 2013, shall be completed prior to the first occupation of the building.
description: Variation of condition 2 of Planning Permission 01076/G/P14 dated 23/12/2010 for replacement of part of the rear ground floor of the public house with a single storey rear extension with a glazed canopy area and alterations to the rear car park and rear external areas.
